Dialogue_Text: There are times when an obstacle needs to be thrown a couple of floors down.
What is this? Is this the roof of the Iron Throne headquarters?
I do know that, and I am not going to hesitate when someone needs to be pushed and taught how to fly.
I am not going to be like Sarevok!
Yes. So you remember how we climbed up this tower. Perhaps you also remember how it felt to stand here, look at everything and everyone. Those people were so small. Like ants.
I never thought that way about them.
Yes. That's more or less what I thought when I was here.
I don't think I ever reached the roof. But I must have been on the floor just below us.
Are you sure? Why wouldn't we have that thought?
I know. We are the same.
But you must have at least imagined how it would feel to stand here.
Good. I'm glad to hear that.
Aren't we already like your brother?
There are people who believe reaching towers like this allows people to feel closer to gods. But when we walked the pavement below us, we were just as wonderful. Just as strong. And just as thirsty.

It's always been like that: the longer one walks, the stronger the thirst becomes. And while we do need to drink water, there is also a different kind of thirst that we suffer from. But you do know that.
How can you be so sure?
Yes. I know what you are referring to.
Because I am your blood. I am your thirst. You do need to feed me, or we both die.
It sounds like you know what it means to be honest with yourself. And I am quite glad you always knew that it's not just water that we crave.
Now, will you jump with me? Shall we continue our discussion down there?
What?! No! Are you insane?
I don't think this is a good idea.
Of course. Let us jump. One. Two...
Have some faith, will you?
...three.
